description: NS OV Fiets is a shared-mobility system listed in the GBFS registry used by Mobility Database. Its listed geographic coverage is Netherlands, country code NL. The registry System ID is ns_ov_fiets, and the listed GBFS versions are 1.0. The descriptive metadata name NS as the operator. The discovery metadata advertise station descriptions, station availability. The JSON auto-discovery endpoint links to the system's published components. Auto-discovery returned HTTP 200 during the metadata check. The registry does not state feed-use charges; the licence field retains any provider declaration found in system-information metadata. Station and vehicle data were not downloaded, and current operation or completeness is not established by a registry listing. The resource can provide shared-mobility supply inputs for transport accessibility, network and capacity studies when the relevant components are available. The related Mobility Database catalogue record documents the discovery source.
